commit_message:
decomp: complete worldmap character and player model (A2DE 4.207681%)

Reconstruct WmCharacter task/update/render/resource lifecycle and complete
WmPlayerModel rendering/resource loading. Correct ModelAnm::create to BOOL
and the WmPlayerModel update parameter width.

Add 5,044 matching code bytes and 23 matching functions over a2945ad.
Totals: 121,032 / 2,876,454 code bytes and 1,441 / 15,667 functions.
All 1,418 previously matching functions remain matching; matching data rises
from 4,028 to 4,276 bytes with all denominators unchanged.

The full source build and objdiff report pass locally. Public CI recompiles
the sources and reproduces the new-function fingerprints before publishing.
No ROM or extracted original game binaries are included.
